title: Ola Cruiser Electric Concept (Urban Commuter)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Ola Electric Ola Cruiser Electric Concept (Urban Commuter) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Step-Through Upright posture paired with an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 14L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
